Un'istituzione che, grazie alla sua posizione ideale, si trova simultaneamente sia in prossimità della città che in un ambiente rilassante e verde. Una piccola gemma che soddisfa il suo mandato di servizio cantonale con cura personale in un'atmosfera privata per i pazienti di tutte le classi di assicurazione. The private clinic Obach is something very special in the Swiss hospital landscape: a small house that has been committed to medical care at the highest level for 100 years. An institution that, thanks to its ideal location, is simultaneously located in both close to the city and relaxing, green surroundings. A small gem that fulfills its cantonal service mandate with personal care in a private atmosphere for patients from all insurance classes. The private clinic Obach offers a wide range of services with a special focus on orthopaedics and urology. Job description
